build_torchscript_func: build a TorchScript function from an execution trace node's op schema and input/output types
build_triton_func: build a compiled Triton kernel function from source code and an async compiler
is_tensor: check if a node's input or output at a given index is a single Tensor type
is_op: check if an execution trace node is an operator node with optional strict parent validation
import_third_party_modules: import a list of third party Python modules by name and raise on failure
